children: According to Wallstreetcn, South Korea's first investment project under its U.S. trade agreement is a natural gas power plant in Texas, and it is evaluating nuclear power and an Alaska project as the next U.S. investment projects, while saying annual investment in the U.S. will not exceed a $20 billion cap.

title: South Korea's First U.S. Trade Deal Investment Project Is a Texas Gas Power Plant
